title: sphaeralcea cuspidata
intro: Sphaeralcea cuspidata, commonly known as the Copper Globe Mallow, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family, Malvaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Sphaeralcea cuspidata include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and show potential as an antiviral agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
